summary.text: Ryan Spain is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 73, in office since 2017, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Peoria city council member, he co-chairs the Administrative Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Spain was born on October 11, 1982, in Peoria, Illinois, and graduated from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.
He then earned an M.B.A. from Bradley University.
His career experience includes serving as a Peoria city council member and as a board member of the Downtown Development Corporation of Peoria.
Spain assumed office in the Illinois House in 2017 and advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the House Executive, House Financial Institutions, Gaming, International Relations, Tourism, and Trade, Rules, and Transportation: Regulation, Roads & Bridges committees, and as co-chair of the Administrative Rules Committee.
Ballotpedia lists Nicole Dopler (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.
